name: Voxel explainer
description: Blocky voxel presenter and a little box creature on a deep-blue starfield, step chips and cards. Friendly tech explainer.
rules: A 3D voxel presenter in the lower half, cards in the upper half, captions at the bottom.
A companion creature reacts (hops) on the key word of the shot.
Step chips (STEP 1 .. n) appear top centre with the card.
Hero shirt must be lighter than the background (readability): check luma.
Yellow is the accent: one yellow word in captions.
camera_language: Medium shot mostly, slow push; close only for reactions.
typography: Heavy sans, white with yellow accent.
audio_direction: upbeat groove, pop on card, tick on step chip, hop = boing
pitfalls: Creature cropped by the frame edge.
